technique_name: Come up with an AI-powered solution to reduce food waste.
description: An AI-powered solution to reduce food waste could involve using machine learning algorithms to analyze data from sources such as grocery stores or restaurants in order to better predict the amount of food that needs to be ordered or cooked. The data sources can involve historical sales records, food demand, weather data, and other pertinent information.
